preamble:
Repository source readers, separate from the runtime helpers in Test_utils.

Linking ppxlib pulls in the compiler archive, whose units are forced into every native executable. Keep that dependency on the scanning side (gh-ocannl-2010).
content:
module Config_key_scan : sig ... end

Scanning OCaml sources for the config keys they read, shared by the configuration-consistency tests.

module Lifecycle_scan : sig ... end
module Dune_stanza_scan : sig ... end

Reading dune files for the places that run a test executable.

module Config_dep_resolution : sig ... end

Which configuration each test-running site's process reads, and whether its dependencies name it: config_dep_completeness's resolution, over a tree handed in as data (gh-ocannl-603).

module Slot_kind : sig ... end

Reading dune files for the stanzas that run a test executable, and whether they declare the shared ocannl_config.

module Cache_dir_scan : sig ... end

Scanning OCaml sources for the autotune schedule cache directories they name, so that the one root .gitignore glob over their shared prefix covers all of them.

module Refused_action_scan : sig ... end
module Refusal_control_scan : sig ... end

Relating repository-scanner refusal diagnostics to permanent control goldens.

module Refusal_section_heads : sig ... end

The fixed text the refusal-control section printer writes for readers outside its process, tools/mutation-run.sh among them, which reads it from the source (gh-ocannl-1840).

module Refusal_control_manifest : sig ... end

Extracting static refusal-diagnostic fragments from repository scanners and relating them to permanent control goldens.

module Refusal_manifest_sync : sig ... end

Rewriting Refusal_control_manifest's stale rows, keys and labels after a diagnostic is reworded: tools/refusal-manifest-sync.sh's engine (gh-ocannl-1429).

module Optional_arg_scan : sig ... end

Classifying whether lib/ optional arguments affect their function bodies or are deliberately unimplemented, in which case the caller-visible label must begin with an underscore.

module Verdict_callee : sig ... end

Whose a claim name is -- Verdict's, ambiguously so past an open of another module, or not: the one resolver every Verdict reader asks (gh-ocannl-1361).

module Verdict_scan : sig ... end

Scanning test sources for claims a test decides itself and prints outside Verdict, where a failing one is dune promote-able into the golden.

module Verdict_provenance : sig ... end

Scope-and-polarity provenance of the Boolean a Verdict claim receives: which quantifiers it can rest on, through bindings, helpers, wrappers, matches and modules, and which populations are witnessed non-empty when it holds.

module Doc_examples_scan : sig ... end
module Agent_notes_scan : sig ... end

Reading docs/agent-notes.md and docs/agent-notes/ as structure: bullet integrity, index-hook agreement, table shape, reachability from the index, and repetition across files.

module Markdown_link_scan : sig ... end

Checking the closed inline-link dialect against repository source paths.

module Dead_export_scan : sig ... end

The source reader behind the dead implicit-export ratchet.

module Api_drift : sig ... end

Enumerating source-declared values in modules without interfaces and conservatively counting external qualified, aliased, opened, and included references to them.

module Codegen_text_scan : sig ... end

Deciding what pins the TEXT of generated code: goldens holding emitted kernel or IR source, and test sources asserting on it from a string literal.

module Kernel_exec_scan : sig ... end

Deciding which tests compile or execute kernel text they built themselves -- a staged callback, a ?prelowered compile, or a support value reaching either -- the population a codegen change breaks without any of it pinning text (gh-ocannl-1685).

module Scan_attempt : sig ... end

Classifying a scan's failure on one source: the input's parse error, or the scanner's own exception with its text -- never the second reported as the first.

module Source_inventory : sig ... end

A source-only repository inventory derived from a clean Dune sandbox. Repository scans select their corpus from this shared set instead of maintaining recursive source-root lists.

module Rerun_aliases : sig ... end

Which aliases re-run a file that pins the text of generated code: read from the dune files, the rule diffing a golden or the stanza running a source (gh-ocannl-1533).

module Scan_argv : sig ... end

Response-file expansion for the repository-wide scans: a @<path> argument stands for the words in that file. What a scan reads is handed to it on the command line, and Windows caps a command line at 32,767 characters.

module Scan_floors : sig ... end

Floors over a scanned census: the tripwire that keeps a scanning test from passing vacuously, shared by the scans that glob the repository.

module Lexical_scope : sig ... end

The lexical scope model the source scans resolve names over: which binding an identifier reaches where it is spelled, parameterised over what a name denotes (gh-ocannl-1079).

module Ll_test_scan : sig ... end
module Operand_key_scan : sig ... end

Finding operand fixtures that mint values from a hand-rolled modulus of a multi-axis key instead of going through Ll_test.cycle's blind-axis guard (gh-ocannl-1018).

module Exact_partials_scan : sig ... end

Prose claiming the exactness of partial sums, and whether an Ll_test.exact_partials derivation stands beside it (gh-ocannl-1729).

module Mutation_serial_scan : sig ... end

Holding every write to the inference session's module-level mutable state to Row.note_mutation, or to an in-place classification (gh-ocannl-1506).

module Open_node_scan : sig ... end

Holding every tensor node a module of tensor/ creates to Tensor.note_open_node, the uid list a rewind discards by (gh-ocannl-1579).

module Debug_name_scan : sig ... end

Holding every test's use of a node's debug name to display, never lookup (gh-ocannl-1606).

module Label_dispatch_scan : sig ... end

Holding the compiler's reads of a node's label or namespace, and of a backend's name, to display, a copied label or a marked site, never a decision (gh-ocannl-1783).

module Tensorized_census_scan : sig ... end

Finding executed claims about a tensorized routine whose item judges no mma census, which parity alone cannot replace (gh-ocannl-1309).

module Provenance_tag_scan : sig ... end

Where the virtualizer's rejection codes are minted, which files name them, and the boundary test's phase table checked against the minting functions (gh-ocannl-1015).
